correctness.rationale: For every integer N>=2 and positive J_i,gamma,kappa, the initial state remains in a three-dimensional invariant subspace. The 3x3 matrix X supplied in RESULT.md is verified entrywise to satisfy L(X)=-P. Strict dissipativity plus absence of undamped eigenoperators on the reachable block ensures X=integral rho dt. Its trace yields the stated formula. AM–GM proves uniqueness of both positive rate optima and the exact minimum. The coherent dark state proves zero-noise divergence. A standalone independently assembled full-space Liouvillian test verifies 96 unequal-weighted cases, three finite-time tests and 345 rate-optimum groups; finite checks do not replace the proof. Full global stability of inaccessible dark states is not claimed.

value.rationale: Dark-state trapping is a fundamental transport obstruction. The exact all-weight, all-size theorem yields a nontrivial simultaneous and independently tunable optimal source dephasing and trap strength, with quantified Zeno/weak-noise boundaries. It is an experimentally interpretable design law for a natural quantum star rather than an arbitrary finite case or a reformulated general principle.
